WITH status_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans,
    SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute
  FROM status_metrics
)
SELECT
  sm.healtheval,
  sm.total_scans,
  sm.gb_per_minute,
  sm.gb_per_minute - sa.average_gb_per_minute AS above_average
FROM status_metrics AS sm
CROSS JOIN status_average AS sa
WHERE sm.gb_per_minute > sa.average_gb_per_minute;
